images.alt: Outdoor Access Commission Chief Executive, Dan Wildy, holding a chocolate fish while standing on the public right of way that gives access to Lowes Bush Scenic Reserve in the background.

post.text:
Our CE Dan Wildy is sending a chocy fish to Richard Murcott, who worked diligently with LINZ to digitise public access to Lowes Bush Scenic Reserve. This work has allowed us to make it visible on our digital maps and, in so doing, share it with everyone.
🗺️ maps.herengaanuku.govt.nz/Viewer/?map=...
